33:1.text: ! Keep your duty to Allâh, and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites
. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knower, All-Wise.

33:2.text: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Verily, Allâh is Well-Acquainted with what you do.

33:3.text: And put your trust in Allâh, and Sufficient is Allâh as a Wakîl

33:4.text: Allâh has not made for any man two hearts inside his body. Neither has He made your wives whom you declare to be like your mothers’ backs, your real mothers.
[az-Zihâr is the saying of a husband to his wife, "You are to me like the back of my mother" i.e. You are unlawful for me to approach]
nor has He made your adopted sons your real sons. That is but your saying with your mouths. But Allâh says the truth, and He guides to the

33:5.text: their fathers: that is more just with Allâh. But if you know not their father’s
your brothers in faith and Mawâlîkum
. And there is no sin on you concerning that in which you made a mistake
, except in regard to what your hearts deliberately intend. And Allâh is Ever Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

33:6.text: The Prophet is closer to the believers than their ownselves,
. And blood relations among each other have closer personal ties in the Decree of Allâh
, except that you do kindness to those brothers
(when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم joined them in brotherhood ties)
